label: Messenger
html:
<style>
  /* Relay: the scaffold's own glue - layout and the messenger look; every
     control is a shipped component (Session, Bubble, Marker, Textarea, Dropdown,
     Popover, Dialog, Switch, Avatar) */
  .wa {
    --wa-accent: oklch(0.7 0.17 152);
    --wa-out: oklch(0.94 0.07 145);
    --wa-panel: var(--background);
    --wa-wall: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 70%, oklch(0.93 0.03 85));
    container: wa / inline-size;
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: var(--scaffold-height, 50rem);
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--wa-panel);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  .wa-app {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    height: 100%;
  }
  .dark .wa {
    --wa-out: oklch(0.38 0.07 165);
    --wa-wall: color-mix(in oklab, var(--background) 85%, oklch(0.4 0.03 200));
  }
  .wa-toggle {
    position: absolute;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* rail */
  .wa-app {
    grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  }
  .wa-rail {
    order: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: space-around;
    padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    & :is(.wa-brand, .wa-rail-spacer, .wa-rail-me) {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  @container wa (min-width: 48rem) {
    .wa-app {
      grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
    .wa-rail {
      order: 0;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      padding: 0.75rem 0;
      border-block-start: 0;
      border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--border);
      & :is(.wa-brand, .wa-rail-spacer, .wa-rail-me) {
        display: revert;
      }
      & .wa-brand {
        display: grid;
      }
    }
  }
  .wa-rail {
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 55%, var(--background));
  }
  .wa-brand {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 2.25rem;
    height: 2.25rem;
    margin-block-end: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--wa-accent);
    color: #fff;
    & svg {
      width: 1.25rem;
      height: 1.25rem;
    }
  }
  .wa-tab {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 2.5rem;
    height: 2.5rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    cursor: pointer;
    & input {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      margin: 0;
      opacity: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    & svg {
      width: 1.25rem;
      height: 1.25rem;
    }
    &:hover {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: var(--foreground);
    }
    &:has(:checked) {
      background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--wa-accent) 18%, transparent);
      color: var(--foreground);
    }
    &:has(:focus-visible) {
      outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }
  }
  .wa-tab-badge {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    right: -0.125rem;
    min-width: 1.125rem;
    height: 1.125rem;
    padding-inline: 0.25rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--wa-accent);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 0.625rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.125rem;
    text-align: center;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  .wa-tab-dot {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.375rem;
    right: 0.375rem;
    width: 0.5rem;
    height: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--wa-accent);
  }
  .wa-rail-spacer {
    flex: 1;
  }
  .wa-rail-me {
    margin-block-start: 0.25rem;
  }

  /* side panels */
  .wa-side {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--wa-panel);
  }
  /* the list sits in a divider Resizer: on a phone it is the whole screen (no handle) */
  .wa-split {
    width: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .wa-split > .resizer-handle {
    display: none;
  }
  .wa-panel {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
    flex: 1;
  }
  .wa:has(input[name='wa-tab'][value='chats']:checked) .wa-panel[data-panel='chats'],
  .wa:has(input[name='wa-tab'][value='calls']:checked) .wa-panel[data-panel='calls'],
  .wa:has(input[name='wa-tab'][value='updates']:checked) .wa-panel[data-panel='updates'],
  .wa:has(input[name='wa-tab'][value='settings']:checked) .wa-panel[data-panel='settings'] {
    display: flex;
  }
  .wa-panel-head {
    display: flex;
    flex: none;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    height: 3.75rem;
    padding-inline: 1rem 0.5rem;
    & h1,
    & h2 {
      flex: 1;
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 1.375rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    & h2 {
      font-size: 1rem;
    }
  }
  .wa-panel-label {
    margin: 0.75rem 1rem 0.25rem;
    color: var(--wa-accent);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .wa-search {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 0.75rem 0.5rem;
    & svg {
      position: absolute;
      inset-inline-start: 0.875rem;
      top: 50%;
      translate: 0 -50%;
      width: 1rem;
      height: 1rem;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    & .input {
      height: 2.25rem;
      padding-inline-start: 2.5rem;
      border-color: transparent;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 80%, transparent);
      box-shadow: none;
    }
  }
  .wa-filters {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    padding: 0 0.75rem 0.5rem;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    & label {
      position: relative;
      flex: none;
      padding: 0.3125rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--muted);
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    & input {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      margin: 0;
      opacity: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    & label:has(:checked) {
      background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--wa-accent) 20%, transparent);
      color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--wa-accent) 55%, var(--foreground));
    }
    & label:has(:focus-visible) {
      outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }
  }
  /* the filter chips filter the list - pure :has() */
  .wa:has(input[name='wa-filter'][value='unread']:checked) .wa-chats .wa-chat:not([data-unread]),
  .wa:has(input[name='wa-filter'][value='fav']:checked) .wa-chats .wa-chat:not([data-fav]),
  .wa:has(input[name='wa-filter'][value='group']:checked) .wa-chats .wa-chat:not([data-group]) {
    display: none;
  }
  .wa-archived {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem;
    color: inherit;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-decoration: none;
    & svg {
      width: 1.125rem;
      height: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--wa-accent);
    }
    & span {
      flex: 1;
    }
    & small {
      color: var(--wa-accent);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    &:hover {
      background: var(--accent);
    }
  }
  .wa-chats {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 0.375rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
    list-style: none;
  }
  .wa-chat,
  .wa-call-row,
  .wa-story,
  .wa-me {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.875rem;
    padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
    & > .avatar {
      width: 3rem;
      height: 3rem;
    }
  }
  .wa-chat {
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
    &:hover {
      background: var(--accent);
    }
    &[aria-current] {
      background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 90%, var(--foreground) 4%);
    }
    &:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
      outline-offset: -2px;
    }
  }
  .wa-chat-main {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    min-width: 0;
    & strong {
      overflow: hidden;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    & strong[data-missed] {
      color: var(--destructive);
    }
    & small {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.25rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
  }
  .wa-chat-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    & time {
      flex: none;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
    }
  }
  .wa-chat[data-unread] .wa-chat-top time {
    color: var(--wa-accent);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .wa-chat-bottom {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .wa-chat-preview {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    & em {
      color: var(--wa-accent);
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
  }
  .wa-chat-icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    & svg {
      width: 0.875rem;
      height: 0.875rem;
    }
  }
  .wa-unread {
    flex: none;
    min-width: 1.25rem;
    height: 1.25rem;
    padding-inline: 0.375rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--wa-accent);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    text-align: center;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  .wa-group-avatar .avatar-fallback {
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--wa-accent) 25%, var(--muted));
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .wa-encrypted {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    & svg {
      width: 0.75rem;
      height: 0.75rem;
    }
  }
  .wa-call-dir {
    display: inline-flex;
    & svg {
      width: 0.875rem;
      height: 0.875rem;
    }
    &[data-kind='missed'] {
      color: var(--destructive);
    }
    &[data-kind='in'],
    &[data-kind='out'] {
      color: var(--wa-accent);
    }
  }
  .wa-story {
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .wa-ring {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 3.375rem;
    height: 3.375rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: conic-gradient(
      var(--wa-accent) 0 30%,
      transparent 30% 34%,
      var(--wa-accent) 34% 64%,
      transparent 64% 68%,
      var(--wa-accent) 68% 96%,
      transparent 96%
    );
    &[data-seen] {
      background: var(--border);
    }
    &[data-me] {
      background: none;
    }
    & .avatar {
      width: 3rem;
      height: 3rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--wa-panel);
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
  }
  .wa-ring-plus {
    position: absolute;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 1.25rem;
    height: 1.25rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--wa-panel);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--wa-accent);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .wa-me {
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
    margin: 0 0.375rem 0.5rem;
    & > .avatar {
      width: 4rem;
      height: 4rem;
    }
  }
  .wa-settings {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 0.375rem;
    list-style: none;
    & li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
      padding: 0.875rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    }
    & li:hover {
      background: var(--accent);
    }
    & li > svg {
      width: 1.25rem;
      height: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
    }
    & span,
    & label {
      display: grid;
      gap: 0.125rem;
      cursor: default;
    }
    & small {
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
    }
  }

  /* conversation */
  .wa-main {
    display: none;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .wa-threads {
    position: relative;
    height: 100%;
  }
  .wa-thread {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .wa-welcome {
    display: none;
    height: 100%;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 2rem;
    background: var(--wa-wall);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    text-align: center;
    border-block-end: 6px solid var(--wa-accent);
    & > svg {
      width: 4rem;
      height: 4rem;
      color: var(--wa-accent);
    }
    & h2 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--foreground);
      font-size: 1.75rem;
      font-weight: 300;
    }
    & p {
      margin: 0;
      max-width: 24rem;
    }
    & small {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.25rem;
      margin-block-start: 2rem;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
    }
    & small svg {
      width: 0.75rem;
      height: 0.75rem;
    }
  }
  .wa-thread-head {
    display: flex;
    flex: none;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    height: 3.75rem;
    padding-inline: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 55%, var(--background));
  }
  .wa-thread-who {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0.25rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    & .avatar {
      width: 2.5rem;
      height: 2.5rem;
    }
    & span {
      display: grid;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    & strong {
      overflow: hidden;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    & small {
      overflow: hidden;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    & small[data-typing] {
      color: var(--wa-accent);
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    &:hover {
      background: var(--accent);
    }
  }
  .wa-thread-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.125rem;
  }
  .wa-back {
    display: inline-flex;
  }
  .wa-session {
    flex: 1;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    background: transparent;
  }
  .wa-session .session-viewport {
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding: 1rem clamp(1rem, 6cqi, 4rem);
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent) 1.5px, transparent 2px)
        0 0 / 28px 28px,
      radial-gradient(circle at 70% 75%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 4%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1.5px)
        0 0 / 22px 22px,
      var(--wa-wall);
  }
  .wa-session .session-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    margin-block-start: auto;
  }
  .wa-session .session-footer {
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 55%, var(--background));
  }
  .wa .bubble {
    --_r: 0.625rem;
    --_rs: 0.125rem;
    --_py: 0.375rem;
    --_px: 0.625rem;
    max-width: min(75%, 34rem);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0.5px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.12));
  }
  .wa .bubble[data-variant='secondary'] {
    --_bg: var(--background);
    --_fg: var(--foreground);
  }
  .dark .wa .bubble[data-variant='secondary'] {
    --_bg: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 90%, var(--foreground) 6%);
  }
  .wa .bubble[data-align='end'] {
    --_bg: var(--wa-out);
    --_fg: var(--foreground);
  }
  .wa .session-item:has(> .bubble[data-tail]) + .session-item > .bubble,
  .wa .session-item:has(> .marker) + .session-item > .bubble {
    margin-block-start: 0.375rem;
  }
  .wa-meta {
    float: inline-end;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.1875rem;
    margin: 0.5rem -0.125rem -0.25rem 0.75rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    line-height: 1;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .wa-ticks {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  .wa-ticks[data-status='read'] {
    color: oklch(0.65 0.15 235);
  }
  .wa-ticks[data-status='sent'] .wa-tick2 {
    display: none;
  }
  .wa-sender {
    display: block;
    margin-block-end: 0.125rem;
    color: var(--c);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .wa-day {
    justify-content: center;
    margin-block: 0.5rem;
    & .marker-content {
      padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: var(--background);
      box-shadow: 0 1px 0.5px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1);
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
  }
  .wa-day::before,
  .wa-day::after {
    display: none;
  }
  .wa-system {
    justify-content: center;
    margin-block: 0.25rem;
    & .marker-content {
      padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.9 0.08 95) 70%, var(--background));
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
    }
  }
  .wa-photo {
    padding: 0.1875rem;
    & img {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 20rem;
      border-radius: calc(var(--_r) - 0.125rem);
    }
    & .bubble-caption {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0.375rem 0.375rem 0.25rem;
    }
  }
  .wa-quote {
    display: grid;
    margin: 0 0 0.375rem;
    padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem;
    border-inline-start: 4px solid var(--c);
    border-radius: 0.375rem;
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    & strong {
      color: var(--c);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    & span {
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
  }
  .wa-link {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 5.5rem minmax(0, 1fr);
    margin-block-start: 0.375rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 0.375rem;
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 6%, transparent);
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
    & img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }
    & span {
      display: grid;
      gap: 0.125rem;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem;
    }
    & small {
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
    }
  }
  .wa-file {
    margin-block: 0.375rem 0;
  }
  .wa .bubble-content :is(.wa-link, .wa-file) {
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .wa-voice {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    min-width: 16rem;
  }
  .wa-voice-play {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 2rem;
    height: 2rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    & input {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      margin: 0;
      opacity: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
